summary: In this excerpt from Book 14, the narrator, Zenobia (called Zen), meets with a group that includes Geoff (called Call Me Cheese), Zeke, Jason (known as Gargle), and Ian in a tent-lined space they have borrowed. Jason explains the fabric blocks radio and cell signals, making the space a Faraday cage that Zen recognizes from her own backpack. The group then discusses her brother, an FBI sting that recruited an informant, and a fugitive who is still on the run and has been texting Zen over the Convo app.
one_line: Zen and her companions meet in a signal-blocking tent to discuss her brother, an FBI sting, and a fugitive still on the run.
key_facts: The narrator's name is Zenobia, and she says she can be called Zen for short.
Geoff, called Call Me Cheese, says Zenobia was a badass woman warrior who led a rebellion against the Romans.
Jason, whom the narrator knew as Gargle, says a friend recently bought the building and plans to convert it into a community makerspace.
Jason says the tent fabric blocks radio waves and cell signals and is portable security for sensitive communications.
Jason says the group is demoing the tent at the security conference.
The narrator made her backpack into a Faraday cage using layers of duct tape and foil.
Ian says the group has identified the crook who was recruited as an informant.
Ian says the group uncovered the FBI agent running the sting and found nothing embarrassing in his past.
Zeke mentions a tenth grade yearbook photo as embarrassing, but Ian's point is that nothing would discredit the agent.
Ian says one person is still on the run.
The narrator says the fugitive, called Wheeze, has sent her a few texts.
The narrator says she and the fugitive are both running Convo, which Zeke wrote.
Zeke warns about a kernel problem in the latest update that caused some devices to be bricked.
The narrator replies that they are running current versions and that she knows enough to keep systems updated.
Jason asks how much the fugitive knows about surveillance, and the narrator answers that he is pretty informed.
